author: mara
story: An Ops incident tool without a model: it merges a charge point's OCPP errors, its live status and its tickets into one sorted timeline, and a second page adds the timeline text to the ticket through ctx.confirm. Mara builds the timeline for a German charge point and adds it to its open ticket, confirming the write.

input.text:
